items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: One was named Hunyadi. ... outside of Hunyadi. They didn't even know how he called Hunyadi.

ctx.x: But that begins in New York. He collaborated on jazz band Ball. On the fidgety feet. And I think, yeah, because the client at Marmalade was one of my numbers. And he collaborated on that. Just he and Regis' name on that. See, because every one of the names on it, the guys were getting jealous. They think that my name shouldn't, their name shouldn't be on that. So I put one of their names on it. And you're bringing me into a place a little ahead of time. But I just want to go on to it now. So, Liverstable Blues.…
Oh, excuse me. Why did you get that name, Taddy Eagles' Nest Down? Did that have anything to do with it?
